claims.claim: The CMRE source contains 15 mission maps, one launcher map, and five core or art Mod packages.
All mission maps and the launcher compose through CMRE_Core_Triggers, which loads CMRE_Core_Base plus Mengsk and Stetmann commander Mods.
Base Catalog data and trigger runtime require further commander/shared/UI/AI decomposition before extraction.
